rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded day-5 blastocyst with thinned zona, good ICM, and somewhat loose/sparser TE; appropriately notes limits of static-image grading. Minor issue is speculative reclassification to 3BB range without definitive image proof.

Integrates age, prior live birth, endometrial thickness, PCOS, oocyte yield, missing AMH, sperm parameters, and lifestyle factors well, and connects them appropriately to prognosis and embryo quality.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with morphology and age-related euploidy risk appropriately driving prognosis. Minor overreach in discussing reserve ambiguity and TE downgrade from a single image.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: SET, luteal support, uterine optimization, reserve review, and nuanced PGT-A counseling. Slight deduction for some speculative suggestions (e.g., DNA fragmentation/antioxidants) that are not universally guideline-driven.

Provides clear next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, checking progesterone/cavity factors, reserve testing, and protocol review. Useful and practical, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than highly case-specific.
